meta.title: Implement selective file push for GitHub multi-file sync to reduce unnecessary writes
meta.body_summary: Add selectiveSync feature flag and getChangedFiles utility to push only changed JSON files during GitHub multi-file sync, reducing unnecessary writes and speeding up syncs.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added selective file push with feature flag and unit tests, but PR closed without maintainer review or performance benchmarking.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 446 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium addition by absolute volume, concentrated in a new utility, tests, and a few integration changes. It fits a moderate performance optimization PR but was closed without merge—likely due to lack of maintainer engagement rather than scale.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human feedback; only a changeset-bot warning about missing changeset.
review_details.performance_claim: Selective file push reduces unnecessary writes, speeds up syncs, and cleans commit history when multi-file sync enabled.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed without merge; no explicit rejection from maintainers, but no acceptance either. Only bot comment about missing changeset.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Feature addition with thorough unit tests and feature flag, but no maintainer engagement led to the PR being closed without review, likely due to insufficient maintainer bandwidth or trust in Agent-authored changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks, profiler data, or before/after metrics; unit tests ensure functional correctness but not speed improvements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge, effectively rejecting the change; no regression occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Add a selectiveSync feature flag, getChangedFiles utility to detect changed token files, filter changed files in GitTokenStorage.push, and integrate with RemoteTokens; includes unit tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files account for the majority of line additions; the production change is modest.
change_trajectory: Implementation of selective file push with feature flag, utility, integration, and unit tests.
Test mock fix for useChangedState hook dependency.
